verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains only AI developer building blocks: a Select AI Java SDK, the Select AI Agent Framework for defining agent teams, and importing models into OCI Generative AI. None of it documents a built-in feature that generates insights or suggestions from the user's data inside the product, so these primitives earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
